data.title: US spot Ethereum ETFs see $1B outflows in Octob... | Pluang
data.description: In October 2026, US spot Ethereum ETFs experienced over $1 billion in net outflows, marking the longest streak of daily withdrawals since their 2024 launch. This occurred even as on-chain Ethereum staking reached record levels, indicating differing investor approaches to the asset. BlackRock's iShares Ethereum Trust led the outflows, contributing nearly half of the October 30 redemptions. Despite the outflows, total net assets in these ETFs remain strong at about $13.22 billion, and Ethereum's price held steady between $2,200 and $2,500, showing the market's resilience to ETF selling pressure.
data.author: Crypto Briefing
